attempts.rationale: The series shows strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a simple mean over all models should give a robust baseline.
The series shows strong seasonality and unstable ranking; try a robust weighted combo that down‑weights high‑error models via a softmax on negative error.

Ranking is unstable and several models show correlated errors; a per‑model inverse‑error weighting could give a more robust weighted combination than the mean.
